beam-free.source: Reflection developer docs, Models (https://developers.reflection.ai/models): Beam-1.0-501B-A23B reports reasoning.supported_efforts max/xhigh/high/medium/low with reasoning mandatory, and the free tier serves the same model. models.dev's opencode-go entry lists the same five rungs, so this gateway exposes them for beam-free.

minimax-m3.1-flash-free.source: MiniMax Responses API reference (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/responses-create): MiniMax-M3.1-Flash always reasons and reasoning.effort accepts low/medium/high/xhigh/max (none returns HTTP 400). models.dev's opencode-go entry lists the same five rungs.

step-5-preview.source: StepFun Step Plan reasoning guide (https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/step-plan/integrations/reasoning-api): models with three effort levels accept low/medium/high through reasoning_effort, and step-5-preview is listed in the Step Plan model table. models.dev's opencode-go entry lists low/medium/high.

minimax-m3.source: MiniMax Responses API reference (https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/responses-create): for MiniMax-M3, effort only turns reasoning on (any non-none value) and does not tune its depth. models.dev's opencode-go entry exposes a toggle with no effort values, so there is no ladder to send.

qwen3.7-plus.source: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio qwen3.7-plus (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen3-7-plus) documents thinking mode but no effort enum for this id; reasoning.effort exists only on the Responses API. models.dev's opencode-go entry exposes a toggle plus a thinking budget (max 262144) and no effort values, and this extension reaches the model over Anthropic Messages, so there is no ladder to send.

kimi-k2.7-code.source: Moonshot Kimi API reference (https://platform.moonshot.ai/docs/api/chat): kimi-k2.7-code accepts thinking.type=enabled only (thinking is always on; disabled is an error) and no reasoning_effort; the low/high/max ladder belongs to kimi-k3. models.dev's opencode-go entry lists no reasoning options.

longcat-2.0.source: LongCat API docs, Model Parameters (https://longcat.chat/platform/docs/api/model-params): thinking is a binary switch (thinking.type enabled/disabled) plus thinking_budget up to 262144, and the Chat Completions reference exposes no reasoning_effort. models.dev's opencode-go entry lists a toggle only.

longcat-2.5-preview-free.source: LongCat API docs, Model Parameters (https://longcat.chat/platform/docs/api/model-params): thinking is a binary switch (thinking.type enabled/disabled) plus thinking_budget up to 262144, and the Chat Completions reference exposes no reasoning_effort. models.dev's opencode-go entry lists a toggle only.

qwen3.8-flash.source: models.dev provider opencode-go — the gateway's own published catalog — lists effort values low/medium/xhigh for this id. pi-ai carries no thinkingLevelMap here, so this is single-source; it replaces the low/medium/high/xhigh that had been borrowed from Command Code's gateway, which was a guess for a different gateway rather than evidence for this one.

qwen3.8-max.source: models.dev provider opencode-go lists effort values low/medium/xhigh for this id (pi-ai is generic here, so single-source). Replaces the low/medium/high/xhigh borrowed from Command Code's gateway.

mimo-v2.5.source: Xiaomi MiMo Responses API reference (mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/api/chat/responses): reasoning.effort lists none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max/ultra, minimal mapped to low and xhigh/max/ultra mapped to high, so low/medium/high are accepted rungs. The chat-completions and anthropic pages document only thinking.enabled|disabled, which is why this ladder had been dropped in 0.1.82 — the Responses page was missed.
